name: Bazel International Ltd
about:

keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
BIL, registered as a Non-Systematically Important Non-Deposit Taking Non-Banking Finance Company, is involved in trading shares, providing financial services, and undertaking investment activities. It also offers credit facilities to individuals and businesses, including business loans to meet working capital requirements for individuals and corporate entities.
